notes: Wall time is run createdAt to updatedAt, including job scheduling. Per-job duration is completedAt minus startedAt.
Main run had no browser job and skipped Python; after adds both obligations. Single-run comparison, not p95.

Whole-job RSS is unavailable; chaos maxRssBytes is the maximum reported per-iteration child RSS, not whole-job memory or a retained-engine soak. No OOM observed. Every required job ran and reported success on the PR run.

PR checkout runs on GitHub synthetic merge a20f30bf7f9d9c147624ba280e5adb71d0a0e695, against main 21b2a1edfae98e7ab9b63a34943372331c94ba70. The main comparison is ec97bfd; A/E integration and host variability prevent attributing the difference solely to job splitting.
